[[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms']] '''Flame Carbine'''<ref name="ROE" /> was a type of personal [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]]. They generally cost around 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] apiece.<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> The weapon was used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Marines (SpecForce)|SpaceOps]] and [[Pathfinders/Legends|Pathfinders]], and was the favored weapon of choice for [[Urban Guerrillas/Legends|Urban Combat Specialists]] in street-fighting operations.<ref name="ROE" />
